import json
def solve(inp):
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    # find bounding boxes of non-zero regions
    boxes=[]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if inp[r][c] and not seen[r][c]:
                # flood fill this color region
                col=inp[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if seen[a][b]: continue
                    seen[a][b]=True; cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and inp[x][y]==col and not seen[x][y]:
                            stack.append((x,y))
                rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
                boxes.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,col,cells))
    boxes.sort(key=lambda b:(b[0]+b[1])/2)  # outer to inner roughly
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    # reassign colors in reverse order
    order=sorted(boxes,key=lambda b:b[0])  # top-to-bottom proxy
    rev=order[::-1]
    for new,col_,_ in zip(rev[:-1],rev[1:] if len(rev)>1 else [],[]): pass
    colors=[b[4] for b in order]
    mapping={colors[i]:colors[len(colors)-1-i] for i in range(len(colors))}
    for b in boxes:
        for r,c in b[5]: out[r][c]=mapping[b[4]]
    return out
